# maxim violation — quality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:maximViolationQuality`](gmeow-maximViolationQuality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/maximViolationQuality>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

Violation of the Gricean maxim of Quality: do not say what you believe to be false or for which you lack adequate evidence. Lies, falsifications, and bullshit violate this maxim.
